title: acre-gui holds several drawings in tabs
body:
acre-gui shows one drawing; `App` holds its path, text, scene, selection, playback, zoom and field.

## Proposal

- A `Document` holds everything that belongs to one drawing; `App` holds the open documents and the active one.
- A tab bar under the menu, one tab per drawing by file name, each with a × that asks to confirm as the window's × does. File > Open adds a tab, or switches to it when the file is already open. Each tab keeps its own selection, zoom and playback, and without a link watches its own file.
- With neovim linked: `:AcreView` in another buffer opens or switches to that buffer's tab instead of replacing the drawing; switching tabs in the viewer sends a new `open {path}` message, and the plugin switches to that buffer, opening it if needed, and moves the link to it.
